subject: POC success criteria & evaluation playbook — Ambassador AI
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@ambassador.ai>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@ambassador.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & evaluation playbook — Ambassador AI

Hi Carmen & Sam — thanks again for a productive demo today. Quick recap + proposal for a focused 2-week POC so we can validate latency, throughput, cost, and end-to-end quality on a representative slice of your workload. Please see the plan below and let me know any immediate objections.

High-level objective:
- Demonstrate Redwood can meet Ambassador AI production constraints while showing unit economics (cost/token) at scale.

Proposed scope (2 weeks):
1) Workload: ~50k tokens/day (chat+summaries), 10k sample requests (provided by Ambassador).
2) Tech targets (pass/fail criteria):
   - Latency: p95 generator latency < 200 ms (95th percentile) for 256-context requests.
   - Throughput: sustain 500 requests/minute for 30-minute window without >1% error rate.
   - Cost: baseline cost/token <= $0.0006 with recommended batching/quantization.
   - Quality: task-specific metric (semantic F1) >= 0.85 on the provided eval set; no more than 2% hallucination on named-entity extraction checks.
3) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 0 (kickoff): exchange sample logs & test dataset (Ambassador -> Redwood).
   - Week 1 (run): Redwood runs baseline config + one optimized config (batching/kv cache).
   - Week 2 (readout): joint metrics review, regression checks, and decision to scale or iterate.

Owners & roles:
- Ambassador: Carmen (technical lead, provides datasets & acceptance evals), Sam (data ops).
- Redwood: Monica (POC PM / success criteria), Ben (commercial lead), Priyom (ops & perf tuning).

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Carmen: share sample request logs and a 200–500 example evaluation set by EOD Thursday (attached sample format is fine).
- Redwood: we will provision a sandbox cluster and share an ingress endpoint + initial test plan by Friday.
- All: 30-minute kickoff on Monday to align on runbook and rollback criteria.

Attachments: sample CSV format for logs (ambassador_sample_logs.csv) — use this to scope tokenization and request shapes.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Monica

From: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@ambassador.ai>

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & evaluation playbook — Ambassador AI

Monica — thanks for the clear write-up. We like the focused approach. A few clarifications from our side:

- The sample logs will be ready by Thursday EOD — these are truncated user conversation logs (PII redacted).
- For quality: our primary KPI is answer relevance (human-rated top-3 precision). We can provide a 500-item human eval set — we'll aim for 100 completed ratings by the end of the run.
- Cost target: $0.0006/token is aggressive but plausible with your batching recommendations; would like a short note in the readout showing cost breakdown (tokens, GPU hours, and infra overhead).

One ask: can Redwood add a simple error-injection scenario to the runbook (simulate 10% malformed requests for a 10-minute window) so we can observe fallback behavior?

If that all sounds good, I'll lock in Monday kickoff at 11:00 PT and share the datasets.

Thanks,
Carmen

Head of Platform
